remarks: Be the first to live in this beautifully renovated 2-bedroom, 2-bath home in the desirable Pemberwick neighborhood of Greenwich! This home features a brand-new kitchen and new appliances. Both bathrooms have been completely updated with fresh, stylish finishes.  The fully finished basement provides extra living space - perfect for a family room, playroom, or guest area, complete with a full bath. Upstairs, you'll find two spacious bedrooms with great natural light.  Enjoy a large backyard along with plenty of parking. Located in a great neighborhood with top-rated schools, this home is just 5 minutes from the train station and 50 minutes from NYC, making it a convenient choice for commuters.  As a Greenwich resident, you'll have access to beaches, parks, shopping, dining, and entertainment. Don't miss this opportunity to rent a fully updated home in one of Fairfield County's most sought-after areas!
